title: Surreal Clock Tower Landscape
description: A surreal scene features a large analog clock integrated into a tall stone tower atop a green hill with a winding path. The composition is set within a circular portal against a pale yellow background, surrounded by floating colorful spheres, two butterflies, two bats, a small sun, and floating rock formations.
prompt: A surreal dreamlike scene with a tall ornate clock tower built into a round clock face standing on a lush green hill with a winding dirt path, all enclosed in a large circular portal. Floating around the circle are colorful spheres, a bright orange sun, a monarch butterfly, a blue butterfly, and several bats. Below are floating rock cliffs with trees and a distant cityscape on the horizon under a pale yellow sky, in the style of fantasy surrealism.
